Component 1 Implementation, Component 2 Preparation of ToR for the below project.Sida contribution to EC funded project shall support sustainable managment of natural resources, biodiversity and nature protection and contribute to bringing the country closer to EU environmental standards and implementation of Natura 2000.

Project has been successfully implemented and finalised. It produced most of expected results, as follow: 122 potential Natura 2000 sites were identified and a full list of 208 species and 70 habitats has been prepared for each of these sites. All data related to potential selected Natura 2000 sites were processed in the GIS platform which allows viewing online as well as extracting them. Unfortunately, after Project finalization there was political dispute among two entity ministries about placing GIS platform in MOFTER (as coordinating ministry) and its common use. Thus it has been decided that platform will be temporarily clo Guidelines for the Natura 2000 sites management plans have been prepared as well as management plans for three proposed Natura 2000 sites: Tišina in Republic of Srpska, Vranica, Orjen-Bijela gora. Legal Regulations/Ordinances to support establishment of Natura 2000 network developed and drafted. Natura 2000 Information System using proposed ICT and GIS standards established. Unfortunately their usage has been also stopped due to political disputes. Communication strategy and Public awareness activities implemented.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
